svg.aria-label: How it works. System: Telegram sends an update to a webhook Lambda, which checks the secret and user and enqueues it on SQS; a worker Lambda consumes it and runs the intake using the triage agent (Google ADK via OpenRouter), the source reader (Browserbase and Stagehand), the review store (Postgres) and Notion. Review loop: the agent drafts, the workflow pauses for your review, then you approve (commit to Notion), reject, or revise with a note, which sends it back to the draft step.
